น้ำหล่อเลี้ยงข้อต่อแห้ง: เมื่ออายุเกิน 3: Dry joint fluid: After the age of 30, the body produces less synovial fluid, so the joint membranes and the cartilage inside rub directly against each other. Every movement therefore causes pain and a cracking sound.
กระดูกอ่อนผิวข้อสึกหรอและเสื่อมสภาพ: กระ: Worn and deteriorating articular cartilage: The cartilage that once acted as a "shock-absorbing cushion" is destroyed by increasing age, excess body weight or heavy physical use, causing the main bones to grind against each other, resulting in inflammation, red swelling and deformity.
มวลกระดูกบางและหนาแน่นลดลง: ร่างกายสูญเส: Thinning bones and reduced bone density: The body loses calcium and important minerals faster than it can replace them, so the inner bone tissue starts to become porous, increasing the risk of brittle, thin bones that break easily.
เนื้อเยื่อและเส้นเอ็นรอบข้ออักเสบเรื้อรั: Chronic inflammation of tissues and tendons around the joints: Once the internal structure of the joint starts to break down, the body is in a constant state of inflammation, causing the tendons and muscles around the joints to tighten, ache, burn and stiffen until you can barely move, and you may lose your freedom of movement.
เพิ่มน้ำหล่อเลี้ยง ลดแรงกระแทก: ช่วยปกป้: Increases joint fluid and reduces impact: Helps protect the joint membranes and stimulates the production of synovial fluid, preventing the cartilage from rubbing together, which is the main cause of pain.
บรรเทาอาการอักเสบเฉียบพลันและเรื้อรัง: ช: Relieves acute and chronic inflammation: Helps relieve swelling, pain and burning, and reduces joint stiffness, making it easier to bend your knees, move your arms and legs, and stand up and sit down, without having to rely on painkillers so often.
ฟื้นฟูส่วนที่สึกหรอทั่วร่างกาย: ตรงเข้าซ: Restores worn parts throughout the body: Goes straight to repairing cartilage cells and tendons that have deteriorated with age, while stimulating the formation of strong new bone cells.
เสริมมวลกระดูกให้หนาแน่น: เพิ่มความหนาแน: Builds dense bone mass: Increases bone density from within, preventing bones from thinning or breaking down faster than normal and reducing long-term concerns about osteoporosis.
